source.name: Talents Forever
source.changes: Normalized class/tree/talent identifiers and field names; no talent text or rank values changed. Icons and artwork omitted.
limits: Fan-maintained beta-client snapshot; not live server tuning or independent in-game verification.
Classic fields are the source comparison reference, normally rank-one text; the source gives no exact Classic client build.
This is a Forever calculator with Classic comparison, not a complete separately allocatable Classic all-rank calculator.
Standard level-10-to-60 point budget only; Legacy Talented extra points are not modeled.
The data license covers the author’s reading, checking and arrangement. Blizzard game names, tooltip text and artwork remain Blizzard’s and are not licensed by the source.

artImportNote: Build .170 separately imports redistributed Blizzard artwork. Original normalized dataset and its data-only import transformation remain unchanged.
